links.outcome: Sonographer workflow efficiency, fatigue, and image quality on AI vs non-AI days in randomized crossover trial
links.effect: AI reduced exam time (13.0 vs 14.3 min, p<0.001), increased daily exams (16.7 vs 14.1, p=0.003), lowered mental fatigue (4.1 vs 4.7, p=0.039), improved image quality (p<0.001).
links.quote: AI assistance significantly reduced examination time (13.0 ± 3.5 minutes vs. 14.3 ± 4.2 minutes, p<0.001) and increased the average number of daily examinations (16.7 ± 2.5 vs. 14.1 ± 2.5, p=0.003).

links.outcome: Sonographer performance with versus without AI in deployment mode, including agreement with final expert-endorsed values
links.effect: Randomized AI-assisted vs manual days; AI measurements within acceptable clinical limits of final expert-endorsed values for 90% of parameters; parameters analyzed 85 vs 25.
links.quote: Differences between AI-generated measurements and final expert-endorsed values were within acceptable clinical limits for 90% of parameters.

screen.reason: The study is a randomized crossover trial evaluating the real-world deployment of an AI-assisted automated echocardiography measurement tool versus manual workflow, focusing on workflow efficiency, sonographer fatigue, and throughput.
